[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe 1: Berry & Reishi Smoothie - Ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed berries, 1/2 frozen banana, 1/4 cup plain yogurt, 1 tsp reishi mushroom powder, 1/2 cup almond milk, 1 tsp honey. Directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe 2: Chocolate & Chaga Smoothie - Ingredients: 1/2 cup almond milk, 1/2 frozen banana, 1/4 avocado, 1 scoop chocolate protein powder, 1 tsp chaga mushroom powder, 1 tsp honey. Directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
